description: Free-plan sites show a small 'Published with deed.page' link in the bottom-right corner; Hobby and Pro never show it. Inputs: show (boolean), optional slug, and token. With slug, the setting applies to that site; without slug, it applies to every site of the token. Only a paid plan removes the badge: on Free, show false returns plan_required with the Hobby price and a signed upgrade_url in message and user_message (show user_message to your human, do not retry), except where the badge was already off before 2026-10-25 (kept); on Hobby and Pro it changes nothing because those plans never show it. show true shows it again. Returns the stored setting and whether the badge is shown. Writes only the setting on deed.page and contacts no outside system.

show.description: true shows the badge again. false is refused on Free (paid-plan perk) and is a no-op on Hobby and Pro.

slug.description: Slug you own. Omit to apply to every site of this token.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
